description: Calculate حق‌الزحمهٔ داوری under the arbitration fee bylaw approved 1401/06/05 by the head of the judiciary (applies when the arbitrator and the parties have not agreed a fee): marginal 2% / 1% / 0.5% / 0.25% bands on the claim with a 1.5 billion rial cap, shared equally among arbitrators; a non-financial claim is 5–30 million rial per arbitrator.
name: calculate_arbitration_fee
title: محاسبهٔ حق‌الزحمهٔ داوری — Calculate arbitrator fee
